description: Latest reported quarter per OEM, April-June 2026 (calendar Q2; SGRE = Q3 FY26, Suzlon = Q1 FY27). Figures are as reported in each company's own definition and currency; the app converts revenue to EUR with the average daily rate of the year to date (data/fx_annual.json).

Vestas.backlog_note: wind turbine order backlog EUR 36.0bn; combined with service agreements EUR 76.9bn
Vestas.guidance: 2026: revenue EUR 20-22bn; EBIT margin before special items 7-9% (raised from 6-8%)
Vestas.also: Q1 2026: revenue EUR 3,966m, EBIT before special items EUR 127m (3.2%), orders 4,504 MW.
Vestas.source: Vestas company announcement, Interim Report Q2 2026 (12 Aug 2026) and Q1 2026
Vestas.orders_value_note: EUR 3.4bn as stated in the report summary (rounded)

Nordex.backlog_note: total order book EUR 18.4bn (projects EUR 11.6bn, service EUR 6.8bn)
Nordex.guidance: 2026 guidance confirmed (a third-party summary cites sales EUR 8.2-9.0bn and EBITDA margin 8-11%; not checked against the primary release)
Nordex.also: H1 2026: sales EUR 3,766.5m (+13.8%), EBITDA EUR 354.5m (9.4%). Order intake value is Projects EUR 2,976.5m plus Service EUR 518.9m.
Nordex.source: Nordex Group press release, Q2/2026 results (29 Jul 2026)

Siemens Gamesa.guidance: FY2026: comparable revenue growth 3-5% (raised from 1-3%); profit margin before special items around break-even
Siemens Gamesa.also: First profit before special items since the segment was reported separately in this series; 9M FY26 comparable revenue growth +5.8%.
Siemens Gamesa.source: Siemens Energy quarterly earnings releases, segment Siemens Gamesa

Suzlon.also: Management cites temporary logistics disruption from the geopolitical situation and a change of scope and segment mix.

GE.guidance: 2026: Wind segment EBITDA loss of about USD 400m; organic revenue down low double digits
GE.also: H1 2026 EBITDA -USD 657m against -USD 311m a year earlier.
GE.source: GE Vernova quarterly earnings releases, Wind segment
